description: This is a Java interface defining the service layer for handling user groups in the application. It specifies methods for listing groups by type and by IDs, throwing service exceptions as needed.

classes.name: GroupService
classes.description: Java interface defining methods for managing user groups, extending a generic entity service with capabilities specific to Group entities.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by the specified GroupType, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects based on a set of IDs, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
